expectation: Membrane stain of endothelium: thin rings and tubes outlining vessels and capillaries, forming a branching network in submucosa, lamina propria and between muscle bundles; a scattered minority of cells, plus fainter macrophages and platelets.
notes: Bright tubular and ring-shaped CD31 profiles form a vessel network across the submucosa, mucosa and muscle septa, clearly separate from the dimmer background. The muscle-layer haze is autofluorescence. The structure matches the expected pattern, so this is a real stain.
observed: A: a branching network of bright tubes and rings in the submucosa and mucosa, plus lines along the muscle septa; diffuse haze over the muscularis. B: a vessel at the top edge. C: epithelial haze only. D: an elongated capillary profile. E1: scattered small vessel profiles.
why: A clear, specific vascular network of tubular and ring-shaped CD31-positive structures stands well above the background haze, where endothelium belongs.
